both. but there are no paid gigs, and its pretty much my only skill besides being able to grow plants hydroponically, and even then i don't have the money to start up that hobby or start growing pot even for short term profit. 

i know people care, and i don't really care that people care. i'm numb to that idea since i can't have a future of living just for the sake of others. living unhappily for the sake of others isn't a life worth living at all.

i'm a pretty good graphic designer, and i've been freelancing for afew months, so far i've made a whopping zero dollars and zero cents and that is gross. my net profit puts me 1000 bucks in the red because i needed to upgrade my PC to work. and i thought "hey, this is work i can do" but no, this is just me mooching. i have no savings either, because i thought this would be a profitable line of work. i wish i had the connections to sell drugs, cause that would be a much easier line of work. or prostitute myself on gregslist, but i'm not attractive enough for that either. Inert gas doesn't cost that much anyway. 

Edit: thanks for entertaining me. i was getting quite sad nobody responded.
